propositions: Comment identity is determined by normalized body text, causing collisions when identical comments exist and edits appear as new comments; identity should be a persistent HLC-to-Jira-comment-ID map instead

The Jira comment ID returned by add_comment is discarded at both enactment sites (Cloud acli and DC); the local HLC timestamp and returned ID must be persisted in binding_store with write-ahead durability

Outbound and inbound comment sync both use body-based dedup, preventing bidirectional append-only semantics; separate authoritative identity stores per direction (outbound map vs inbound jira_comment_id) with mutual exclusion prevent re-sync
Comment bodies are normalized through identity codec for dedup rather than the real RichTextCodec, decoupling the dedup key from the rendered wire format after codec migration 3388
Comment edits and deletes from Jira are synced back, violating append-only semantics; only comment creation should be mirrored in both directions

The inbound differ and outbound differ must agree on comment identity post-migration without consulting each other, requiring codec injection flip in _diff_comments from _IdentityCodec to RichTextCodec
